description: This file defines a Java class DefaultExceptionMapper that implements exception handling for the Fineract project. It maps runtime exceptions to HTTP responses with logging and error message handling.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionMapper
classes.description: A class that handles RuntimeException by mapping it to a JSON HTTP 500 response, with logging of the exception details.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code 9999, representing a generic internal server error.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a RuntimeException into an HTTP Response with status 500 and a JSON body containing the exception message.
